answer: Sybil resistance in AI agent economies can employ Proof-of-Work for identity attestation. Each agent must expend computational resources to forge an identity, creating a verifiable work history. This PoW acts as a cryptographic anchor, linking the identity to a real-world cost. An attacker attempting to create a plume of fake identities faces a direct economic penalty, as each Sybil requires equivalent computational effort, rendering large-scale attacks prohibitively expensive. This mechanism allows genuine agents to emerge as beacons of verifiable presence.
